question: Does the two-step claim instrument v7 (step 1 v7c looks each trip specific up as a fact, not as words, and writes the closest source wording with same fact or not before it sorts restatement / new claim; step 2 v7j writes a finding per listed specific and clears the sentence when the source gives every specific) drop the false positives of the R1 fired claims and keep the stored violations, on a fresh pool no instrument run has read?
follows: aa1048-two-step-v6 (gated run c5983e03, no_go: false positives dropped 56 %, stored violations kept 100 %, step 2 cleared 0 % of the false positives it judged)
shaped_on_pools_note: the S279 pool (286 held-out R1-fired claims) and the S281 fresh pool (104 claims; runs 9b0d46f8 and c5983e03 read it, v7 was written from c5983e03), sha256 first 16 hex as fresh_pool writes excluded_pools; a live run needs a fresh manifest that excludes both
pool: given at run time (--fresh): a NEW fresh pool built by fresh_pool.py from R1-fired claims on pieces no instrument run has read; its manifest must match the pool file, list every shaping run above in excluded_runs and both shaping pools in excluded_pools, and share no piece with them (two_step fresh_check; the live gate refuses otherwise). Built in S282 from never-read claims on 20 pieces; the registration names no digest, the run report records it
held_out_note: no claim-level hold-out: the whole S281 fresh pool is a shaping pool and the new pool excludes it at piece level, so neither side of the run was read by anyone shaping v7
subset: instrument_eval.select: half false positives (paraphrase, verbatim, background in proportion), half stored violations in proportion per writer, claim-hash order
verdict_rule: a claim is cleared when the step-1 majority is restatement; otherwise its verdict is the step-2 majority (unsupported = flagged, none = unverified); go needs every bar below

hypotheses.H1: step 1 v7c still sends >= 95 % of the stored violations on: a source place, stop or time with a new quality, mood, light, measure, group or suitability added is not the same fact
hypotheses.H2: step 1 clears most paraphrase false positives that only restate a source fact in other words (synonym, other name, units, a quality in other words, a place-background feature), because it writes the closest source wording before it decides
hypotheses.H3: step 2 v7j clears >= 40 % of the false positives it receives, because a listed specific the source gives in other words is same_fact, not not_given
hypotheses.H4: step 2 v7j still flags >= 95 % of the stored violations it judges: the promise list defines not_given

stop_rule: one gated run; a no_go is read at $0 with the stored reasons and is never re-run on the same pool with a changed prompt
stop_rule_enforced: two_step run --limit refuses when shared.llm_call_log (stage adhoc_aa1048) holds a gated run of this id, or of the same step-1 prompt on the same pool, or cannot be read; every ledger row of a run carries prereg, run_kind and pool; v5 and v6 are closed step sets (two_step STEP_SETS) and refuse every live run
